newsitem.title: GUYANA: Plane hijacked in Guyana found in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Plane hijacked in Guyana found in Colombia.

text.p: A small plane hijacked over Guyana's western jungle two months ago has been found in Colombia, the airline Roraima Airways said on Tuesday.
The Colombian military found the eight-seater aircraft under a canopy of bushes in remote jungle bordering Venezuela earlier this month, the airline said in a statement.
The Guyanese government had asked officials and air traffic controllers in Venezuela and Colombia to watch for the plane, which was hijacked at gunpoint by four passengers.
